scope: Independent read-only review of five versioned release/assessment documents; no new production, bank, Gmail, OCR or financial calls. No full code re-review or rerun of CI. V3 held-out material not accessed by this review.

Area6 previously added stable periodic progress to its normal-flow criterion. The extra periodicity wording is removed and periodicity is explicitly assessed in area28. Area6 stays below8 because the full normal flow is not yet proved.

Real retained report payer/general reference are presented at their source level; missing AIS payer/reference stay unknown. No bank authentication, account authority, report-to-AIS relation or invoice-customer identity is inferred.
assessment.gmail: Separate observed external scheduling receipts can support Gmail fetching; the application external_schedule_verified=false and background_ready=false remain honest.
assessment.noExtraRequirementsAdded: No physical-phone certification, complete financial audit, production allocation or additional bank consent is required solely to satisfy the scoped presentation criteria18/19.

limitations: Production observations were supplied as sanitized versioned receipts by root. This reviewer did not repeat authenticated production reads or inspect private originals.
Public demo geometry/focus checks do not establish authenticated end-to-end production use or physical mobile acceptance.
The local Git source-tree comparison corroborates the recorded publication lineage; it is not an independent new deployment query.
V1/V2 remain failed independent optical first probes. OCR workflow_run success does not establish periodic scheduling or field-quality acceptance.
Backup covers the recorded362-file snapshot and excludes later imports; synthetic disaster recovery is not a production restore.
This is a review at the recordedSite64/versioned-document cutoff. Future releases and later scheduler observations require their own evidence.
